description: TypeScript migration and project infrastructure. Install TypeScript and @types packages, create tsconfig.json, rename vite.config.js→vite.config.ts and tests/setup.js→tests/setup.ts, update package.json build script to run tsc type-check, create .env.example, update .gitignore, update index.html for WattWise branding, create Kiro spec files (.kiro/specs/wattwise/requirements.md, design.md, tasks.md), and update README.md. This FEAT leaves the app in a buildable, all-tests-passing state before any new feature code is written.
steps: Install TypeScript and React type definitions: `npm install --save-dev typescript@5.7.3 @types/react@19 @types/react-dom@19`. Confirm they appear in devDependencies in package.json.

Create tsconfig.json at project root with the exact content specified in the task spec: target ES2020, lib [ES2020, DOM, DOM.Iterable], module ESNext, moduleResolution bundler, allowImportingTsExtensions true, resolveJsonModule true, isolatedModules true, noEmit true, jsx react-jsx, strict true, noUnusedLocals false, noUnusedParameters false, noFallthroughCasesInSwitch true, include [src, tests].
Rename tests/setup.js to tests/setup.ts. The content stays the same (import expect from vitest; import * as matchers from @testing-library/jest-dom/matchers; expect.extend(matchers)).

Rename vite.config.js to vite.config.ts. Update the file to the exact vite.config.ts spec: import defineConfig from vite, import react from @vitejs/plugin-react. In the test block: globals true, environment jsdom, setupFiles './tests/setup.ts' (updated from setup.js). Remove the old firebase inline field that was in vite.config.js.

Update package.json: change scripts.test to 'vitest run', add scripts.typecheck as 'tsc --noEmit'. Confirm build script remains 'vite build'. Add @types/react and @types/react-dom to devDependencies if not already there.
Update .env.example to exactly match the spec: six VITE_FIREBASE_* variables with empty values (no placeholder text like replace_with_your_api_key — just empty values after the = sign).
Update .gitignore to include the spec pattern: .env, .env.*, !.env.example (already present — verify and leave as-is if correct).

Update index.html: change title to 'WattWise — Electricity Tariff Intelligence', update meta description to 'Compare electricity tariff plans and estimate your bill with AI-powered insights.', change meta theme-color to #0A1628, update script src from /src/main.jsx to /src/main.tsx.

Create .kiro/specs/wattwise/requirements.md with EARS-format acceptance criteria covering all 15 categories: Google authentication, Guest calculator, Consumption Digital Twin, Bill calculation, Tariff comparison, Break-even analysis, Risk simulation, Regret calculation, Peak Shift Advisor, Saving comparisons, Custom tariffs, Firestore security, Accessibility, Error handling, Tests and build.

Create .kiro/specs/wattwise/design.md covering: architecture overview, routes table, component tree, TypeScript models (exact interfaces from spec), mathematical formulas (billing, fingerprint, break-even, risk, regret, shift), scenario-generation algorithm, break-even binary search algorithm, Firebase integration pattern, Firestore data model (users/{uid}/comparisons/{id} and users/{uid}/customPlans/{planId}), Firestore security rules, testing strategy.
Create .kiro/specs/wattwise/tasks.md with ordered implementation tasks referencing requirements from requirements.md.

Update README.md to describe WattWise: project purpose, setup instructions (copy .env.example to .env, fill Firebase values, npm install, npm run dev), available routes, technology stack, and disclaimer that all sample tariffs are for demonstration only.
acceptance_criteria: Running `npm run test` passes all 96+ existing tests without modification to calculateBill.test.js, comparePlans.test.js, tariffEngine.test.js, or catalogue.test.js
Running `npm run build` succeeds without TypeScript errors (the build command triggers Vite which respects tsconfig)
tsconfig.json exists at project root with strict: true and the exact compiler options from spec
vite.config.ts exists and vite.config.js no longer exists
tests/setup.ts exists and tests/setup.js no longer exists
.kiro/specs/wattwise/requirements.md, design.md, and tasks.md all exist and are non-empty
.env.example has all six VITE_FIREBASE_* keys with empty values
index.html title is 'WattWise — Electricity Tariff Intelligence'
verification: npm run test — all 96 existing tests pass
npm run build — build succeeds, dist/index.html exists
findings: All 96 existing tests pass with setup.ts rename and vite.config.ts update. Created src/main.tsx as entry point (index.html references main.tsx; original main.jsx kept). tsconfig.json includes src and tests. TypeScript 5.7.3 installed with @types/react@19 and @types/react-dom@19. All .kiro/specs/wattwise/ spec files created. Build produces dist/index.html with WattWise title. Chunk-size advisory for lucide-react/recharts is expected (not an error).
